# `pos shift` commands

## `pos shift close`

Close a shift with counted cash; expected equals float plus cash sales less change and cash refunds. Captures a read-only Z report and over/short. Posts nothing. Retry the same permanent operation_key and count safely. Needs pos.sell; making a deposit separately needs ledger.post.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | pos.sell |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.shift.close` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow pos shift close --shift 01J00000000000000000000000 --counted 149.50 --operation-key evening-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "pos shift close", "input": {"shift": "01J00000000000000000000000", "counted": "149.50", "operation_key": "evening-1"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shift` | `--shift` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `counted` | `--counted` | string | yes | no | — | An amount in the home currency, such as "20" or "24.50".; minimum length 1; maximum length 32; pattern "^\\d+(\\.\\d{1,2})?$" |
| `operation_key` | `--operation-key` | string | yes | no | — | The ticket's key, chosen by the device when the sale starts (a ULID or any 1-64 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'). It is the sale's operation key: completing again with the same key returns the sale already posted and never posts a second.; pattern "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,63}$" |

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.shift.close`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

## `pos shift open`

Open a counted register shift with an opening float. One open shift per register; permanent operation_key makes retries safe. Posts nothing. Needs pos.sell.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Capability | pos.sell |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/pos.shift.open` |
| External binary body | none |
